root_cause: eef_tool_length_m omitted for non-object_pair fixtures in frozen_scripted_controller_config
mechanism: RoboLab absolute IK commands the Robotiq flange pose, but scripted waypoints describe the finger-pad grasp center 0.14 m below the flange. object_pair alone received eef_tool_length_m=0.14; other fixtures defaulted to 0.0, commanding descend/lift heights ~0.14 m above the object at close.
shared_fix_summary: Apply eef_tool_length_m=0.14 in frozen_scripted_controller_config for every fixture; consolidate all live-control runners through tools/v4_natural_grasp_live_control_runner.py.
negative_control_specificity: All fixtures hold_only controls passed with trigger_eligible=false before fix, confirming detector specificity.
